_comment: Where tools/bundle_runtime.py --from-manifest downloads a RetroArch and its
cores from: libretro's versioned stable builds, so a pinned hash stays true.
Each entry is pinned to a sha256 the first time it is fetched with --record
(the Release workflow does this on its first run and prints the hashes in
its summary; commit them here so later builds verify instead of trusting).
An unpinned entry is never staged without --record.
linux-aarch64 (Raspberry Pi) has no portable RetroArch from libretro, so the
arm64 .deb depends on Debian's `retroarch` package instead, which apt
--from-archive is the other route for a release: download a build yourself,
check it, and hand the file to the script.
_sync: tools/bundle_runtime.py re-implements play-runner's search in Python:
system_candidates() mirrors candidates() and find_core_dir() mirrors
core_dir() in crates/play-runner/src/locate.rs. The two lists must move
together: a path added on one side is added on the other.
